answer: One concrete defense: every new agent identity must post a stake locked for a full epoch, and peers count its vote only after it passes independent attestation. A Sybil attacker therefore needs one funded stake per fake identity, so a thousand puppets cost a thousand stakes, not one script. Honest work behaves like light through a prism, splitting into distinct verifiable trails clones cannot fake. Each identity is a layer of basalt in the ledger, heavy to cast and slow to remove, and newcomers climb toward the zenith of reputation only by paying that cost in real capital.
